                                  Financial results for 02 FY27

               Consolidated profit after tax off 6,367 crore in 02 FY27. a growth of 29%.
               Consolidated assets under management at f 584,624 crore as on 30 September 2026.

          the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
